topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Good morrow, neighbor. I've been thinkin' over yer request to use part of the yard for a garden. The soil by the eastern fence does look particularly rich this year, thanks to St. Francis for guidin' the rain evenly. I reckon a bit of shared labor could bring blessings upon us both. If we tend the land with care, sure the saints will smile. I trust ye know the ways of the earth. Let’s start with plowin’ the ground together when the next clear day comes. Mayhaps we can share the bounty come harvest, as is only right among folk who toil under the same sky.
